title_zh: 直播烧烤翻车变成芭比Q了
title_en: New Slang, New Stories (16/20): A Barbecue Livestream Goes Totally "Barbie Q"
note_en: 一边……一边…… links two actions happening at the same time: 小亮一边收拾残局，一边自嘲 "Xiao Liang cleaned up the mess while making fun of himself." English uses "while" once, but Chinese puts 一边 in front of each verb phrase, and both actions share the same subject.
